h:
此工作流程是对旧合并工作流程的更新和大规模升级。

此工作流程的目的是通过生成两个单独的图像，然后将其组合成单个合并图像来简化超现实构图。

每个图像的强度以及图像的组成可以通过潜在的混合, 模型采样和 LoRA model_strength旋钮。

最后，该图像将被传递到重新渲染器/细化器以进行最后 4-10 个步骤。

LoRA 可以在这里找到： https://civitai.com/models/2264765?modelVersionId=2549232

这个工作流程有什么作用？

该工作流程的目的是让 LoRA 在生成过程的后期使用，以强制输出成为超现实的图像合成。

此工作流程包含哪些内容？

工作流程的顶部（如图所示）是合并图像以创建远距离合成的地方。

该工作流程还附带一个独立部分其中仅连接 LoRA 加载器和标准节点，只需一个提示即可创建简单的图像。

o.en:
This workflow is an update - and a massive upgrade - from the older merge workflows.

The intent of this workflow is to simplify surreal compositions by generating two separate images which are then combined into a single merged image.

The strength of each image as well as the composition of the image can be controlled through thelatent blend, model sampling, and LoRA model_strengthknobs.

Finally, that image is then passed off to the re-renderer/refiner for the final 4-10 steps.

The LoRA can be found here: https://civitai.com/models/2264765?modelVersionId=2549232

What does this workflow do?

The intent of the workflow is for the LoRA to be used late-stage during the generation process to force the output into a surreal image composition.

What is included in this workflow?

The top portion of the workflow (as seen in the images) is where the images are merged to create far-out compositions.

The workflow also comes with astand-alone portionwhere just the LoRA loader and the standard nodes are connected to create simple images with just a single prompt.
